Each table element reference shall be subscripted except when such reference appears

cases.reason: General format identical (LINAGE data-name-1/integer-1 LINES, FOOTING, TOP, BOTTOM); GR1-GR8 identical (GR6 only respells 'LINAGE -COUNTER special register'). 2023 adds SR1 (data-names not subject to OCCURS) and drops 'may be qualified'; neither changes the 2002 operand set: a data-name cannot be subscripted and 2002 8.4.1.2.2 SR5 already forbids an unsubscripted table-element reference here, and qualification is general in both. LINAGE is an FD clause and governs no CD entry; data-name-1 may name a communication-section item in 2002, but the rule only reads its value, which does not depend on where the item is stored. Page size and page body are defined by this rule in both.

Probe: after successful READs RL holds 5, 12 and 2 at both editions.
